notes.title: Update 1.1.0.5 - Small Fixes and Small Health Bars
notes.notes:
[h3]FIXED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]fixed an issue that caused game to show black screen when anti-aliasing is forced by graphic card drivers and removed "bfv_alt_renderer.bat" file as this workaround is no longer needed
[*]fixed a bug that caused Airpad's arming progress to reset when game was loaded
[/list]
[h3]ADDED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]added an option to adjust health bars to unit's sprite size
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.1.0.4 - Bug Fix
notes.notes:
[h3]FIXED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]fixed an issue that caused all enemy AIs to be disabled after first oponent has been defeated in SCN_03
[*]fixed an issue that caused Advisor Sounds and Text Messages to not appear after game was loaded in SCN_05
[*]alerts for super weapons will no longer be shown when super weapon is launched by the player in SCN_05
[/list]
[h3]ADDED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]added an option to disable fog of war in SCN_05
[/list]
[h3]CHANGED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Terra Prima's airstrikes launched by the player should now be much more accurate

notes.title: Update 1.1 - Scenarios
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=yooUgOArxWE;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]FIXED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]fixed wrong pipe setup in top-left base in mission CE_07
[*]corrected few typos
[/list]
[h3]ADDED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]added possibility to choose a different music track in game
[*]added Scenarios Menu with 5 extra missions currently playable (more to be added in the future)
[*]added 2 new music tracks
[/list]
[h3]CHANGED:[/h3]
[list]
[*]abilities are now highlighted to better guide players in first missions
[*]special ability in mission CE_03 is now highlighted when it is supposed to be used
[*]added a label informing about a possibility to skip text rollout in Tactical Map
[*]grid placement cursor for building deployment now shows as white even if given square is under the fog of war
[*]when workers are selected together with combat units using box selection command card will always show combat units orders
[*]increased unit limit to 100 (from 80)
[*]decreased difficulty of mission CE_01 (first three waves now have only 1 enemy)
[*]decreased sight radius of Rocket Turrets (16 -> 13)
[/list]
